text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.I'm Jin.Today, we will talk about science.Please get your student's book and your worksheet ready.In this class, you will listen to some conversations about warning signs, and you will learn how to express them in different ways.I hope you will be aware of the importance of rules and the public safety in your life.First, let's check last lesson's homework.Please take out your homework sheet.Are you ready?Let's talk about exercise C.Have you finished it?Here is one of my student's instruction report.It's about how to make a party hat.Look, this is a party hat.Let's read the report together.All you need is carton paper and a piece of string.First, draw something you like on the carton paper.Next, cut a fan out of the carton paper.Then, roll it in a cone.After it, make two holes at the bottom.Finally, connect two holes with a piece of string.When you are at the party, you can put it on your head.Thank you, guys.Do you know how many steps we need to make a party hat?Did my students use imperatives to give instructions?What verbs did he use to describe the steps?Draw, cut, roll, make, and connect.Making a party hat is easy and interesting, isn't it?If you like the party hat, have a try.So much for the homework.What signs do you see in your pants, reverse, or fountains?Are they direction signs, instruction signs, information signs, or warning signs?We usually see these signs.They are warning signs.Look, Alice is holding two warning signs.Peter and Jill are talking about the signs.Do you know why they are talking about the signs?Let's listen and complete the sentence.Why are they talking about the signs?To prepare a game for the water festival.Now, let's listen again and tell what these signs mean.I've prepared a game about signs.To play the game, you have to know what my signs mean.This sign means people mustn't dive.This sign means people mustn't swim.Here the verb dive means jump into water.And this sign means people mustn't swim.Very good.From the listening, we learned that we can use people mustn't do something to express warnings.Please read after me.People mustn't dive.People mustn't swim.Do you have other ways to express warnings?Here are six warning signs.Let's read them carefully and find out the ways to express warnings and write them down.Please take out your worksheet and complete task one.Time's up.Let's share the answers.Look at picture one.We can use no doing something.Also, no can be followed by a noun, just like picture one no ball games to express warnings.From picture two and four, we can learn that the sentence structure, something is not allowed, can express warnings as well.Here allow is a verb.It means let somebody do something.Allow.Something is not allowed means people mustn't do something.Fishing is not allowed.It means people mustn't fish.Look at picture three and six.We can use don't do something to express warnings.Now let's look at the six signs one by one and try to express warnings.What does this sign mean?Playing ball games is not allowed.We can also say people mustn't play ball games or don't play ball games.In the first sentence, we don't use are.Instead, we use is.Do you know why?Because the subject of the sentence is playing ball games, not games.Picture two.People mustn't fish.Don't fish.No fishing.Picture three.What does the sign mean?Try to answer the question in different ways.Let's listen to my students' answers.It means playing with toy boats is not allowed.People mustn't play with toy boats.No playing with toy boats.Thank you, Tom.That's correct.Pay attention to the verb phrase.Here we should use play with.Let's look at the pictures and complete the two sentences.The boy is playing football.Play football means 踢足球。The cat is playing with a football.Play with means 玩耍。Of course, a cat can't play football.Now let's have some practice.Here are another three warning signs.Please say something about their meanings in different ways.Now let's listen to some of my students' answers.What does sign for mean?It means throwing coins is not allowed.People mustn't throw coins.No throwing coins.Don't throw coins.Thank you, Calvin.Next one.It means don't drink the water.People mustn't drink the water.No drinking the water.Drinking the water is not allowed.Thank you.Picture six.What does sign six mean?It means don't leave rubbish.People mustn't leave rubbish.No leaving rubbish.Leaving rubbish is not allowed.Well done.All of you have known how to express warning signs in different ways.Now I will show you more pictures.Look, what a wonderful place it is in Shanghai.We can visit different kinds of sea animals in the pavilions, even underwater.Also, we can watch some animals' excellent shows in the theatre.We can even take a cable car to overlook the whole park and enjoy tasty food in the underwater restaurant.How amazing!Do you know which place it is?Yes, it is an ocean park.Many tourists come to visit the ocean park every day.However, some of them do something wrong or dangerous.In order to tell people what they mustn't do in different places, the ocean park needs a few warning signs.Look, do you know what these signs mean?Please think it over.Let's share the answers one by one.Sign A means don't use mobile phones.Where do we usually see the sign?In the theatre.Next one, sign B means smoking is not allowed.Where do we usually see it?In all indoor public places.Sign C means don't knock the glass.In the sea animal pavilion.Next one, it means you mustn't feed the animals.I fully agree, because you don't know how to feed them.Sometimes animals may attack people.Warning signs are used to remind people what they must do or what they mustn't do.And in some public places, safety warnings or rules are given in a broadcast.Look, this is the entrance of the ocean park.Let's listen to the broadcast message and answer the questions.What warning tips have you heard?Let's listen.Dear tourists, now you are at the entrance of the ocean park.To enjoy your trip, please pay attention to the safety warnings and follow the rules of the park.Don't throw coins into the fountain.Don't leave rubbish.Please queue up where you buy the tickets.Thanks for your cooperation.We wish you have a good time.A broadcast message is a good way to remind people, isn't it?Now the ocean park needs more recordings of broadcast messages for these three places.Pavillion, theater and cable car.Would you like to help them?Please choose one place and complete a broadcast message to give warning tips.Attention, please.When you design the warning tips, don't forget to check whether the warning tips are reasonable and whether you express the warning signs correctly.Please take out your worksheet and complete task two.
